title: Canon of the Tangling Throw
summary: Teaches casts that cross the cords in flight and the pegged tripline that finishes a tangled runner.

title: Treatise on Weighted Cord Mastery
summary: Teaches a master's control of the swung weights, from extended casts to orbiting sweeps and a web of staked cords.

title: Manual of the Snaring Line
summary: Shows how a pegged and hauled line takes a quarry's feet, with crossed lines laid as traps.

title: The Complete Art of the Thrown Weights
summary: Gathers the full range of bolas work for xiantian students, ending in a sweeping tangle and a two-target finish.

title: The Twin-Weight Course of the Basin
summary: A paired-hand course of dual casts and twin wraps taught in the basin schools, closing on the hawk-pair descent.

title: Hawk and Azure Cord Manual
summary: Trains the hawk's stoop and sighting in the cord, from a plunging cast to the ring of cords under the azure sky.

title: Treatise of the River Pair Cast
summary: Teaches two weights thrown as a pair, flowing like twin currents, from the bank check to the river-mouth tangle.

title: Manual of the Wind-Sworn Cast
summary: Teaches a thrower to take a bearing on the wind and cast with it, ending in a tripline along the plateau edge.

title: Bearing and Oath of the Cord
summary: Binds the thrower's bearing to a sworn oath of the cord, from steady snares to a web laid on open ground.

title: Treatise of the Open Plateau Throw
summary: Teaches casting across open ground with no walls, from long wind-fed throws to a wide sweep of the sky.
